sources.entry: sktime - A unified scikit-learn-style framework for forecasting and other time-series learning tasks.

summary.one_liner: sktime is a Python library providing a unified scikit-learn-style interface for time series learning tasks such as forecasting, classification, regression, clustering, and anomaly/changepoint detection.
use_cases: forecast future values of a time series
detect anomalies or changepoints in time series
tune and validate time series models with scikit-learn tools
wrap statsmodels or tsfresh tools for time series work
notable: Unified interface across forecasting, classification, regression, clustering and detection tasks
Composite model building: pipelining, ensembling, tuning and reduction
Reduction lets scikit-learn regressors solve forecasting tasks
Extension templates for building custom estimators compatible with the API
Curated optional dependency sets installable via pip extras
caveats: Not all soft dependencies are installed by default; only a curated selection per task
Several modules are marked maturing or experimental rather than stable
conda install does not support dependency sets
